slides.texte_overlay:
How to fully restart your life
in the next 90 days

Rebuild your body | Movement:
•Train three times a week, no excuses.
•Walk every day, even 20 minutes.
•Learn to cook five simple meals.
•Same bedtime most nights.

Reset your home | Space:
•Throw out what you don't use.
•One clean surface you protect.
•Make your bed every morning.
•A place for everything.

Guard your time | Focus:
•Delete the app you waste most time on.
•One hour a day for your main goal.
•Learn something new daily.
•Say no faster.

slides.texte_overlay:
Level up your work | Career:
•Ask for feedback every two weeks.
•Learn one skill your field needs.
•Show up early, leave nothing half-done.
•Help someone else win.
